title: Give it half the key.
slide_intent: Introduce delegated authority through a routine purchase so a visitor can connect an unfamiliar product idea to a job they recognize.
strategic_value: A visitor can connect the promise of delegated authority to an everyday job, buying SOL on a schedule.
demonstration: The depicted home screen combines a balance, an allowance, two other keys and one outstanding request.
practical_value: Use as the first image in a store listing to establish the category and teach readers how to recognize a key.

content_islands.name: Headline field
content_islands.spec: Use a signal-blue field. Set large white, left-aligned type with a break after “half”. Beneath, in smaller pale type, set “A self-custody Solana wallet with an agent that runs your routine.”

content_islands.name: Phone and balance
content_islands.spec: Center a black-rimmed phone, about three quarters of the panel width, with its top roughly one third down and its foot cropped. On the pale screen, place the small split mark and a bell above “Balance” and $12,480.22.

content_islands.name: Featured key
content_islands.spec: Center a blue dot field on a white card. Beneath it place “Weekly SOL buy”, “$40.00 of $40 left this week” in blue, then the Friday 09:00 Jupiter schedule.

content_islands.name: Other keys and ask
content_islands.spec: Stack compact Rent buffer and Kamino guard rows, then a black “1 ask” strip showing the $410 USDC repayment question and a right arrow.
